title: Truth Seekers
description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD

Об игреTruth Seekers is a class-based immersive horror multiplayer cooperative shooter game that throws players into the heart of environments where urban legends and folklore monsters reside. Join forces with your friends to track down and confront the legendary Bigfoot, and the elusive Stagwalker. Teamwork and strategy are key as you and your team navigate through dangerous encounters. Be careful as you decide whether to stick together or split up; the wrong choice could lead to the gruesome death of a hunter. To ensure smooth coordination, someone must take charge back at the RV, monitoring players' movements and surveillance cameras to call the shots and keep players informed of their surroundings. Do you have what it takes to hunt these urban legends?

CAPTURE THE PROOFProve to the world that these urban legends are more than just myths—the truth is out there…

 

COMMUNICATE BY ANY MEANS POSSIBLEThere are "dead zones" located throughout, which disable long-range communication with the walkie-talkie. Stay in touch by any means necessary.

CRAFT AND FIND GEAR UPGRADES TO AID IN YOUR HUNTFind and craft weapons, medicinal supplies, alcohol, drugs, and other resources to aid in your hunt against these monsters.

WORK TOGETHER, OR IT COULD SPELL DEATHSplitting up can be dangerous, but sometimes is necessary. Will you risk it? 

 

MIND ALTERING SUBSTANCES HELP REDUCE THE PAINShare a beer with your friends or indulge in the forest's natural mushrooms, which can be found throughout. They restore your health, but is it worth the price?

___________________________________

 

FEATURES: 

• 2 maps to hunt with varying difficulty and size, as well as monsters. 

• Advanced, blood thirsty AI that wants you dead.

• Full multiplayer cooperative experience up to 3 players. 

• Crafting and looting.

• 3 character classes to play as: The Hunter, The Tracker, and The Camera Guy.

• And much, much more...
description_short: Truth Seekers is a class-based horror multiplayer cooperative shooter game centered around hunting urban legends and folklore monsters. Find and craft items to aid in your attack, all while strategizing with others to learn the monsters' behaviors before they learn yours...
